entity_name: Council for Development and Reconstruction (مجلس الإنماء والإعمار)

facts.value: Plans, supervises, and executes major infrastructure projects on behalf of the Lebanese Government. Mandate: post-war reconstruction and large-scale infrastructure across all sectors — roads, water/wastewater, buildings, energy, agriculture, and transport.
PRIMARY responsible entity ONLY when a complaint is located inside or directly caused by an ACTIVE CDR construction worksite, regardless of sector.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-019 explicitly tests this: CDR is primary only for active CDR worksites. CDR is NOT default primary for national roads (MPWT is), water pipes (water establishments are), etc.

facts.value: NOT the default routing entity for any generic infrastructure complaint. Default routing: road potholes → MPWT, water pipe leaks → water establishments, electricity → EDL. CDR only becomes relevant when the specific location is confirmed to be inside an active CDR worksite.

Nationwide across all sectors. Total historical contract value: $23.34 billion USD. CDR has 6,160+ total signed contracts. Active project boundaries change continuously. Two tools exist for identifying active CDR projects by location: (1) Project search at cdr.gov.lb/en-US/Projects.aspx — filterable by Sector, Geographic Location, and Status. (2) EU-funded transparency portal at portal.cdr.gov.lb — includes Contracts Dashboard, Funding Dashboard, Maps view, and Reports. The Maps view in the portal is the most useful for CedarFix to visually verify active CDR project locations by governorate and district. CONTRACT STATUS filter in the portal identifies active vs completed projects. Subsector codes visible in portal: AG1, AG2, EC1, EC3, ED1.
facts.notes: Reporting Portal confirmed at portal.cdr.gov.lb on 2026-05-31. Funded by EU. Not a citizen complaint tool — it is a transparency and analytics dashboard. Maps view within portal provides geographic project overlay. Contract Status filter allows active project identification.
facts.human_review_reason: Active CDR project boundaries change continuously. CedarFix routing to CDR requires real-time project location verification via portal.cdr.gov.lb Maps view or cdr.gov.lb project search before any routing decision. Static reference insufficient — HITL always required.

facts.value: Website: cdr.gov.lb. Reporting portal: portal.cdr.gov.lb. HQ address: Tallet Al Serail, Riad El Solh, Beirut, Lebanon. Postal Code: 2023 9201. PO Box: 3170/11. Main phone: 01/980096. Fax: 01/981252, 01/981253, 01/981381. General email: INFOCENTER@CDR.GOV.LB. Project-specific GRM contacts: Roads and Employment Project — 01/980096 ext.317 / GRM.REP@cdr.gov.lb; Lake Qaraoun project — 01/980096 ext.149. No citizen-facing complaint submission form exists on either site — the portal is a transparency dashboard only.
facts.notes: HQ contacts confirmed from cdr.gov.lb/en-US/Contact-Us.aspx on 2026-05-31. Reporting Portal (portal.cdr.gov.lb) confirmed as analytics/transparency tool, not complaint form.

facts.value: Project GRM deadlines are project-specific. Road ESMPs describe: Level 1 — contractor/site engineer handling within one week; Level 2 — PIU social specialist within two weeks; Level 3 — PIU director within two weeks. No universal CDR SLA for non-project citizen complaints. Life-safety hazards always require same-day HITL and emergency routing regardless of GRM level.
facts.notes: Use these SLA targets only for the matching CDR project GRM. Other projects may have different timelines.

facts.value: For an active CDR worksite complaint: (1) Collect project name and location. (2) Verify worksite is active via portal.cdr.gov.lb Maps view or cdr.gov.lb project search (filter by Status + Geographic Location). (3) Route first to site engineer or contractor channel if published for that project. (4) Escalate to PIU social specialist (Level 2) if unresolved after one week. (5) Escalate to PIU director or registered official letter at CDR (Level 3) if still unresolved. (6) For Roads & Employment Project: call 01/980096 ext.317 or email GRM.REP@cdr.gov.lb. (7) For all other contacts: INFOCENTER@CDR.GOV.LB or 01/980096. HITL required at every step — no automated CDR routing.

primary_for_sectors: ROADS_worksite — active CDR road construction or rehabilitation worksite
WATER_worksite — active CDR water/wastewater construction worksite
BUILDINGS_worksite — active CDR public building construction worksite
ANY_sector_worksite — any infrastructure complaint caused by an active CDR worksite
secondary_for_sectors: ROADS — escalation if MPWT fails and CDR project is suspected in the area
not_responsible_for: Generic road potholes or highway defects not at a CDR worksite — route to MPWT
Water pipe leaks not at a CDR worksite — route to relevant water establishment
Any complaint where active CDR worksite presence is NOT confirmed
hitl_conditions: Worksite attribution must be verified via portal.cdr.gov.lb Maps view before routing to CDR
If life-safety hazard inside a CDR worksite: Civil Defense (125) must also be notified
No citizen complaint form exists — citizen must be directed to call 01/980096 or email INFOCENTER@CDR.GOV.LB
Project-specific GRM channel (ext.317, GRM.REP@cdr.gov.lb) only applicable when project is confirmed
